name: librelog
description: Search your local Librelog meetings through the Librelog CLI and local MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Find meetings and read notes, summaries, participants, action items, bounded transcript excerpts, and recurring history from the Librelog database on your computer through the local Librelog CLI and MCP server. Stage summary or memo edits for review in the desktop app, and export complete meeting records when requested. No account or network connection is required.
defaultPrompt: What action items came out of my planning meeting?
Compare the last three meetings in this recurring series.
